resources.string: Shelter uses Android\'s Work Profile to isolate apps. This setup will create a work profile on your device.
Shelter does not request individual permissions on this screen. Android grants Shelter profile-manager access during Work Profile creation; this access is required to manage apps inside the profile.
Some devices may have limited Work Profile support. If you experience issues, please check the documentation.
You are now ready to set up Shelter. Press the button below to begin the creation of your Work Profile.
Setup failed. Your device may not support Work Profiles.
Click here to finish setting up Shelter
Congratulations! You are one click away from finishing setting up Shelter.

Application installation finished in work profile.

Manipulating apps that are hidden from the list could cause crashes and all sorts of unexpected behavior. However, this feature can be useful when faulty vendor-customized ROMs does not enable all necessary system apps in work profile by default. If you continue, you are on your own.

Cloning non-system apps to another profile is currently not possible on MIUI. Please clone your system\'s app store into the other profile and install apps from there.
